It has no special effects, but now that it's been grilled, the pointy ends go down smooth.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Mighty Thistles are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Mighty Thistle]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Despite their pointy ends, Roasted Mighty Thistles can easily be eaten. [[Link]] can restore half a [[Heart]] to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Roasted Mighty Thistle. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Mighty Thistles reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Mighty Thistle]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The roasting process makes Roasted Mighty Thistles easily eatable, no matter their pointy ends. Eating a Roasted Mighty Thistle will heal half a [[Heart]] in [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Mighty Thistle * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
